scripts.build:native: C:\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe -std=gnu99 -fms-extensions -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Inative native/retro_sapi4.c -o retro-sapi4.exe -lole32 -luuid -lwinmm && C:\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe -std=gnu99 -O2 -Wall -Wextra native/original_mouth.c -o original-mouth.exe -lgdi32 -luser32
scripts.render:sample: node src/cli.mjs render --voice "Mike in Stadium" --text-file samples/stadium.txt --out samples/stadium --frame-prefix /samples/stadium.frames/ && node src/prepare-remotion.mjs
scripts.render:remotion: node src/prepare-remotion.mjs && remotion render src/remotion/index.jsx RetroStadium samples/retro-stadium.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
